scenarios.name: delete-not-on-file-short-commarea

notes: GenApp's VSAM 'delete policy' (LGDPVS01, LINKed by LGDPDB01): WF-POLICY-KEY = CA-REQUEST-ID(4:1) + CA-CUSTOMER-NUM + CA-POLICY-NUM, then EXEC CICS DELETE FILE('KSDSPOLY') RIDFLD(WF-Policy-Key) KEYLENGTH(21); on NORMAL it GOBACKs. Each scenario's KSDSPOLY is compared after the task. Every non-NORMAL RESP in this program goes to WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE, whose first act is EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM('LGSTSQ') (GenApp's TS/TD error logger). The harness runs one program, but the case's programs list adds LGSTSQ to the same task (X6, #4607), so the error paths run: NOTFND for a key not on file and IOERR on the DELETE (CA-RETURN-CODE '81'). A task that reaches WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE runs on through LGSTSQ: LGSTSQ writes EIBCALEN + 5 bytes from its 95-byte WRITE-MSG, which is past FROM, and the stand-in and the det port write FROM's bytes then spaces to LENGTH on both sides (X6, ASSUMED, owner 2026-10-21; IBM writes the storage after FROM, undefined), so the logged records and the end state are compared. WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE then copies the COMMAREA into CA-DATA and LINKs LGSTSQ again with the 99-byte CA-ERROR-MSG: IF EIBCALEN < 91 true (a short-COMMAREA scenario, 90 bytes) and false (the full COMMAREA) are both judged. IF EIBCALEN > 0 false needs a call with no COMMAREA, which reads LINKAGE past EIBCALEN 0 (X23-class) and the two sides do not agree on, so no scenario states it. The faults list injects the file RESPs a healthy data set cannot give (IOERR, NOSPACE); the region ASSIGN SYSID is a deployment fact the corpus does not name. NOTOPEN / DISABLED are not injected. Keys: WF-POLICY-KEY is the request-type byte followed by 20 digits, so every key mixes a letter and digits; No browse is issued, so no key order is exercised (the comparison sorts each side's records by key bytes). Data: ksdspoly.txt is built from GenApp's own sample policies (base/cntl/db2cre.jcl's policy rows joined with their endowment / house / motor / commercial rows), laid out as WF-POLICY-INFO (request-type letter + customer + policy number, then the type's 43 bytes) -- the record LGAPVS01 writes; policy 7 (type C, no commercial row) is left out. region.why: a deployment fact: LGSTSQ (the error logger every non-NORMAL RESP LINKs) ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; GenApp names no region in the corpus
